title: Forge Hub | Auto Roll, Webhook Tracking, Auto Rebirth & More
features:
🛠 Notice 🛠

This script is currently in beta. Updates and changes are expected. If you encounter any bugs, have questions, or would like to suggest new features, we’d love to hear from you.

Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!


ROLLING

- auto roll, adjustable delay
- equip best slime automatically on each roll
- hidden roll, hides the roll animation
- pause golden, diamond, and void special rolls individually
- live session stats, rolls per minute

WEBHOOK

- discord webhook url setup
- user id for pings on rare rolls
- adjustable send cooldown 
- test webhook button
- log rolls with min rarity filter
- log all toggle, bypasses the rarity filter
- ping user toggle
- optional session stats in the embed

FARMING

- auto buy next zone, adjustable cap
- teleport to any zone instantly
- auto collect loot, adjustable collection delay
- adjustable walk speed
- infinite jump

UPGRADES

- auto buy upgrades, adjustable delay
- choose which upgrades to prioritise from the full upgrade list
- buy all upgrades at once button
- live display showing how many upgrades are maxed

REBIRTH

- auto rebirth, adjustable goop threshold percentage
- rebirth cap to stop at a set number
- min zone requirement before rebirthing
- manual rebirth now button
- live rebirth info showing goop, cost and luck multiplier

SLIMES

- auto equip best slimes, adjustable interval
- equip best now button
- equip a specific slime by name
- auto use luck potions, ultra luck and roll speed potions
- auto claim index rewards with adjustable interval
- auto feed food to slimes, priority by least xp, most xp or random, choose which food items to use, adjustable delay

MISC

- noclip
- anti afk
- live session stats, uptime, rolls, rebirths and zones
- unload script
